description: This file defines the ShellContext class, which manages the state and lifecycle of a tenant in OrchardCore, including scope creation, reference counting, dependency management, and disposal logic.

classes.name: ShellContext
classes.description: Represents the state of a tenant, managing lifecycle, dependencies, and scope creation.

classes.name: ShellContext.PlaceHolder
classes.description: A placeholder subclass used for lazy initialization of shell contexts.

methods.name: CreateScopeAsync
methods.description: Creates a new ShellScope if the context is not released.

methods.name: ReleaseAsync
methods.description: Marks the shell context as released and initiates disposal.

methods.name: AddDependentShellAsync
methods.description: Registers another ShellContext as dependent, to be released with this one.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for active scopes.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and indicates if the context can be disposed.

methods.name: TerminateShellContextAsync
methods.description: Checks if the shell context can be terminated and performs termination if possible.
